title: Ledger record: result
description: A node or task result linked to claims and evidence (PRD §10.2). `outcome` is a domain outcome that follows a graph edge — `changes_required` and its peers are outcomes, never engine failures (PRD §3.4).

data.$comment: Phase 0: payload shape is deliberately loose. Named properties are optional and documentary; a later task pins the payload contract per record type.

outcome.description: The declared domain outcome of the node or task, e.g. `completed`, `passed`, `changes_required`.
